text:
emily: Heads-up: after the night TS SDK canary (client-js 3.4.0) we saw a small but loud increase in 'unattributed' tokens on the Console. looks routing headers inconsistent.

ryan: I can see the spike in the per-tenant chart. started ~01:05 UTC right after the canary roll.

zoe: any quick repro or logs?

emily: sample recorded from the canary agent:
```http
POST /v1/complete HTTP/1.1
Host: api.internal
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route-Policy: tenant=zephyr;quota=2
X-Route-Hint: tenant=zephyr
```
proxy logs show X-Route-Policy present on ingress but optimizer step receives only X-Route-Hint. looks like client started coalescing headers.

tom: TS runtime uses fetch polyfill that merges duplicate header keys into comma-separated values in some browsers. if SDK added both headers for compatibility, proxy parser might pick the wrong one.

grace: so SDK change to send both headers as fallback had unintended side-effect?

emily: yes, sdk 3.4.0 added fallback header X-Route-Hint based on past proxies. but fetch concat behavior means optimizer sees 'tenant=zephyr, tenant=zephyr' and fails parse.

ryan: deploy-wise: we can 1) revert SDK change, 2) patch proxy/optimizer to tolerate comma-separated values, or 3) send canonical single header from SDK. Revert is slower since customers pick up SDKs on their own. Patch server sounds faster.

zoe: agree patching server to accept comma lists and take first value is safest short-term. also add a parser fuzz test.

ci-bot: test gap noted: header-combination cases missing from SDK+proxy integration matrix. created CI ticket.

emily: can we also add a sampled telemetry field in Console showing "route_header_format" so we can see comma vs single vs missing? helps confirm fix rollout.

grace: I'll own console telemetry change. small tile: % of requests with comma-list route header. low-risk.

tom: i'll push optimizer patch to treat comma-delimited header values as multiple candidates and pick the first valid K=V. canary in 20m.

ops-bot: created INC-2026-0455 for sdk-header-coalesce. assigned: eng-platform, sdks, console.

[25m later]

tom: canary applied to optimizer-pool-2. attributed tokens returned to baseline within sampling window. comma-list cases now parsed.

ryan: metrics look good. thank you.

emily: follow-ups: 1) SDKS should change fallback logic to prefer single canonical header and avoid sending duplicates (owner: tom/ryan) 2) add parser unit+integration tests in proxy (owner: zoe) 3) Console telemetry tile (owner: grace) 4) CI coverage for header permutations (owner: ci-bot team).

grace: will open the telemetry PR and include sample chart.

emily: I'll coordinate SDK PR to make the dual-header opt-in behind env var for one release. avoid surprising proxies.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-0455 updated with links to PRs and will auto-close after postmortem and CI changes merged.

emily: thanks everyone for the quick triage. closing thread once owners ack in their issues. :thumbsup:
